In pursuance of the Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India)(PPP-MII) Order 2017 notified vide the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Order No. 45021/2/2017-PP(B.E.II) dated 15.06.2017 and subsequent amendments dated 28.05.2018, 29.05.2019, 04.06.2020, 16.09.2020 and 19.07.2024, to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India with a view to enhancing income and employment, the following Goods/Services for procurement and manufacturing of Industrial Boilers . (Steam Generators) where there is sufficient local capacity and competition are hereby re-notified with HSN code by the Ministry of Heavy Industries in supersession of earlier Order dated 29.09.2020. 2. Hence, in the procurement of all items of goods and services as under (List A & B), only "Class-I local supplier" shall be eligible to bid irrespective of the purchase value, as per Para 3 (a) of the DPIIT's PPP-MII Order no. 45021/2/2017-PP (BE-II)-Part(4) Vol.II dated 19 .07.2024. This order shall be applicable in respect of the procurements made by all attached or subordinate offices or autonomous body under the Government of India including Government Companies as defined in the Companies Act, and/ or the States and Local Bodies making procurement under all Central Schemes/ Central Sector Schemes where the Scheme is fully or partially funded by Government of India. 4. Ministry of Heavy Industries shall be the Nodal agency to monitor the implementation of this Order. 5. Decision on complaints relating to implementation of this order shall be taken by a committee constituted by Ministry of Heavy Industries (MHI). The Composition of Grievance Committee will be as under: 1. Joint Secretary, I/c of Heavy Electrical Industries Division, MHI Chairman 2. Executive Director, Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited (BHEL) Member 3. Director General, Indian Electrical and Electronics Manufacturers Association Member (IEEMA) 4. Director/DS, 1/c of Heavy Electrical Industries (HEI) Division, MHI Member Secretary 6.
